# Parkly Admin Portal — System Overview & Architecture Context (llms.txt)
> https://admin.parkly.in

## Operational Role
The Parkly Admin Portal is the central operational command center for the Parkly Smart City platform in Chennai.

## Core Modules
- **Overview & Telemetry**: Platform-wide booking volume, GMV, and microservice health probes.
- **Host Verifications**: Autonomous OCR and computer vision adjudication with manual review overrides.
- **User & RBAC Governance**: Driver, Host, and Operations Staff access control.
- **Audit & Security**: Immutable DynamoDB audit log trail and sensor-verified dispute resolution.
